articles.title: CWC and IMD Deploy Advanced GLOF Early Warning Systems in Himalayan Region
articles.summary: High-altitude automated weather and hydrological monitoring stations deployed in Sikkim and Uttarakhand to mitigate Glacial Lake Outburst Flood risks.
prelims: GLOFs occur when moraine dams containing glacial lakes fail due to erosion, avalanches, or seismic activity.
High Mountain Asia (Third Pole) contains the largest freshwater reserve outside the polar regions.
Central Water Commission (CWC) coordinates with IMD and ISRO for real-time hydrological monitoring.
articles.mains: Use as a contemporary case study for disaster risk reduction (DRR), climate change adaptation in fragile ecosystems, and NDMA guidelines on GLOFs.

articles.title: Union Government Operationalizes Data Protection Board under DPDP Act
articles.summary: Ministry of Electronics and IT notifies rules governing the functioning and digital-first grievance redressal platform of the Data Protection Board.
prelims: Data Fiduciary refers to entities determining the purpose and means of processing personal data.
Data Protection Board of India operates as a digital-by-design adjudicatory body handling data breaches.
Cross-border data transfers are permitted by default unless restricted via a government-notified negative list.
articles.mains: Cite in answers on Right to Privacy (Puttaswamy judgment), digital governance, regulatory independence, and balancing economic innovation with civil liberties.

articles.title: India-GCC Free Trade Agreement Negotiations Enter Key Round in Riyadh
articles.summary: India and the Gulf Cooperation Council advance negotiations on market access, service trade, and investment protection.
prelims: GCC consists of six member states: Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, and Bahrain.
GCC represents India's largest regional trading bloc, contributing significantly to crude oil and LNG imports.
Strait of Hormuz serves as the critical maritime choke point connecting the Persian Gulf with the Gulf of Oman.
articles.mains: Valuable for questions on India's 'Think West' strategy, energy security diversification, non-resident Indian (NRI) remittances, and West Asian geopolitics.

articles.title: AgriStack and Farmers' Registry Cross Major Milestone under Digital Agriculture Mission
articles.summary: Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) for agriculture integrates land records and crop-sown data across major agricultural states.
prelims: AgriStack comprises three core registries: Farmers' Registry, Geo-referenced Village Maps, and Crop Sown Registry.
Assigns a Unique Farmer ID linked to Aadhaar for streamlined delivery of PM-KISAN and crop insurance.
Spearheaded by the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare under the Digital Agriculture Mission.
articles.mains: Incorporate into answers on Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), agricultural credit delivery, reduction of yield estimation errors, and precision farming.

articles.title: Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) Directs Strict Monitoring of Stubble Burning
articles.summary: CAQM mandates real-time remote sensing via satellite tracking and expands subsidies for ex-situ crop residue management.
prelims: CAQM is a statutory body established under the CAQM in National Capital Region and Adjoining Areas Act, 2021.
Ex-situ residue management involves converting paddy straw into bio-CNG, pellets for thermal power, and fodder.
ISRO's CREAMS platform provides real-time thermal anomaly data to monitor agricultural fires.
articles.mains: Use as an example of environmental governance, cooperative federalism challenges in air pollution management, and circular bio-economy solutions in agriculture.
